verdict.rationale: Groq's docs reference rate limits scaling with usage tiers (e.g. Flex processing gives '10x higher rate limits' for paid customers, Batch API has 'no impact to standard rate limits', and upgrading unlocks 'Higher Token Limits') but no evidence pack item shows an actual documented rate-limit table or specific numeric limits per tier that a developer could consult before hitting them. Missing for 10: explicit per-tier rate limit tables/numbers, documented request-per-minute/token-per-minute figures, and independent confirmation that these documented limits match production behavior.
